delay.description: Delay between iterations in seconds. Can be a float like 1.5.

iterations.description: Number of iterations to run before exiting. 0 means infinite.

only_io.description: Only show processes/threads currently doing I/O.

accumulated.description: Show accumulated I/O since start instead of bandwidth.

kilobytes.description: Display sizes in kilobytes instead of human-friendly units.

full_cmdline.description: Show full command line including file path and parameters.

si_units.description: Use SI units (1000) for prefixes instead of binary (1024).

graph_source.description: Data source for GRAPH column: io, r, w, rw, sw.

reverse_graph.description: Reverse GRAPH direction (most recent on right).

quiet.description: Suppress headers level: 0 (normal), 1 (no column names later), 2 (never), 3 (no summary).

dead_x.description: Show exited processes with letter 'x' instead of inverse background.

hide_exited.description: Hide exited processes from the output.

hide_time.description: Hide the time clock in the upper right corner.

unit_threshold.description: Threshold value (1-10) to switch to the next unit size.

ascii_chars.description: Disable Unicode drawing characters for graphs.

filter_regex.description: Regex to filter processes by TID or COMMAND. Empty string means no filter.

pids.description: List of PIDs/TIDs to monitor. Empty list monitors all.

uids.description: List of UIDs to monitor. Empty list monitors all.
